G4 identifies the git-SHA/UUID/integrity allow-shapes exempting labelled real secrets regardless of label.
G1 identifies the (^|_) anchoring of GLUED_SECRET_RE dropping prefixed glued credential names.
G2 (and G3) identify TOKEN's '/' making a whole URL path one candidate with the label coming from the api.* host, refusing/redacting ordinary URLs.
No candidate covers purely-numeric 24+ digit path segments over-masked via HEX_BLOB; G8 is about under-masking in the same line.
No candidate notes that redactSensitiveText/containsOutboundSecret ignore backends.entropy.enabled.
No candidate covers the env-deny import bypassing the security/service facade and raising the bypass ceiling.
